# Count cyclists per country by extracting country code from Cyclist column
# The country code is in parentheses after the cyclist name, e.g., "(ESP)"
df['Country'] = df['Cyclist'].str.extract(r'\(([A-Z]{3})\)')
country_counts = df['Country'].value_counts()
# Get the country with the highest count
most_common_country = country_counts.index[0]
answer = most_common_country
